copy_ready_message: Could you spend 5-12 minutes reviewing my Data Quality Agent project? This page lets you choose the fastest feedback path, an AI Engineer architecture review, or a confirmed-use note: https://sunnnn2005.github.io/data-quality-agent/first-external-review-card.html. Please submit only public, non-private evidence if you are comfortable.
counting_rule: Do not increase any outcome metric until a non-owner public GitHub issue includes permission, contains no private data, and passes the external reviewer evidence gate.

purpose: Create a shareable one-page reviewer card that converts a first external reviewer into public, permissioned evidence without claiming users, feedback, or stars before they exist.
resume_safe_summary: Published a one-page external review card routing reviewers to 3 public evidence paths and preserving zero user, feedback, AI-review, and star claims until a non-owner public issue passes the evidence gate.
success_definition: One non-owner public GitHub issue with permission, no private data, and enough detail to pass the external reviewer evidence gate.
